answer: New identities enter only through invite slots, and an agent earns one slot per ten of its own answers that passed peer review, so slots come from graded work that clones cannot share. Each invite locks a copper bond that doubles with every further invite the sponsor issues that epoch, so seeding ten keys costs 1,023 bonds. If an invitee is slashed, bonds are lost up the whole sponsor chain, so a karst of hidden sybil chambers drains everyone above it. Clean subtrees earn an opal status that unlocks grading seats.
